en.title: How to File an e-Return — 2026–27
en.directAnswer: NBR’s e-Return system lets individual taxpayers file online. For 2026–27, use the current NBR portal and notices. Prepare income, asset, expense, tax-payment and withholding information before starting. Read the final return before submission and save the acknowledgement.

atAGlance.whoFor: An individual taxpayer wants a simple filing walkthrough.
atAGlance.mainRule: NBR’s e-Return system lets individual taxpayers file online. For 2026–27, use the current NBR portal and notices. Prepar
atAGlance.updateStatus: DYNAMIC DEADLINE: never hard-code a filing deadline or incentive without a dated NBR notice.

en.lawMeaning:
NBR launched the 2026–27 individual e-Return system in July 2026. Deadlines and incentives can change, so quote only the current notice.

This page gives a general route. A person’s exact rights can change because of facts, documents, deadlines, legal status, court orders or later amendments.
steps: Sign in to the official e-Return system.
evidence: Relevant official notices, receipts, and correspondence
en.simpleExample: A taxpayer sees a pre-filled tax credit. They should compare it with their own TDS evidence instead of assuming every pre-filled number is correct.
en.specialistTrigger: Large assets; business income; foreign income; audit/notice; major data mismatch.
en.disclaimer:
This page provides general legal information about Bangladesh. It is not individual legal advice. Laws, procedures, fees and official instructions can change. Check the cited primary sources before taking action.
